name: Mun Sun-deuk's drift
traveler: Mun Sun-deuk, a skate merchant of Uido
summary: A fish trader from a small island off Korea's south-west coast is blown out to sea and spends three years finding his way home: from the Ryukyu kingdom to Spanish Luzon, then to Portuguese Macau, and overland through Qing China. The exiled scholar Jeong Yak-jeon wrote down his account, with the words he had learned in each language.

stops.note: Caught by a storm carrying skate from Heuksando to the mainland.
Cast ashore in the Ryukyu kingdom.
A ship home goes astray to the Spanish Philippines.
Sent north across China to the capital.
Home after three years and two months.
